title: Week of Aug 3–9
subtitle: Week 8 · Block 2 DELOAD — back off on purpose, bank the block, then road-trip to DC. Big-4 retest starts Aug 10.
goals: This is a deload, and you earned it the hard way — Fri's journal ('exhausted, probably over fatigued'), Sat's 15 on the max set, Sun's HR stuck in Z3–4, and feeling wiped Fri through today. Nothing this week is a test. Lifts drop 10–15% off your tops; every set should feel crisp and easy.

Mileage: ~11–12 mi, all Mon–Fri (Tue 4 w/ light pickups, Thu 4 easy, short flushes Mon/Wed, Fri optional). That's a bigger cut than the usual −30% because Sat/Sun are driving days — good timing, the road trip does the extra trimming for us.

Sat + Sun you're driving to DC: each charging stop = one round of the stop circuit (~8–10 min). 4 rounds programmed; if the day only has 3 stops, skip set 4 — 3 rounds is a complete day. No pull-up benchmark this week (no bar at a charging stop) — it returns Aug 15, fresh.
Side planks are OUT (heard you — 'pretty tired of side planks'). Core stays light and varied this week.
Eat to the SMART goal as always — it auto-drops with the lower training volume, that's it working. 192.5 and tracking to 189.9 by Aug 14; maintenance starts next week for the retest block.
Next week: Block 3, Big-4 retest (Back Squat / Bench / Deadlift / OHP), light re-calibration week first. This deload is what makes those PRs possible — protect it.
review: You closed the block exactly right, including the part where you backed off without being told. What you logged: crossed 20 for the first time in the rebuild — 20.83 mi by your entered miles (Mon 1.5, Tue 5.57, Wed 1.5, Thu 5.0, Fri 1.0, Sat 1.5, Sun 4.76). Incline you rode the ramp to 155 again and owned it. Push Press you finished at 145 — above the 140 we agreed to hold, and a new top. Chest-supported row 150, front squat held 145, hip thrust 160. Friday you were honest: 'exhausted and probably over fatigued' — you kept paused DL at 225 instead of chasing 235 and leg press at 250 instead of 270. That was the right read, not a miss; week 3 of a build is supposed to end heavy-legged. Saturday's max set came in at 15 vs the 19 we chased — that's not strength lost, that's three build weeks of fatigue sitting on the bar, and it's the clearest deload signal in the log. Sunday's run averaged 163 ('way too much zone 3 and zone 4' — agreed; tired legs push HR up at the same pace, another vote for the deload). Scale 192.5–192.6, ahead of pace for 189.9 by Aug 14. Block 2 banked: Front Squat 145, Incline 155, Push Press 145, Paused DL 225, 20+ mi/week, pull-up benchmark 18. Now we cash it in: one easy week, a road trip, and into the Big-4 retest fresh.
